title: The Deadliest Being on Planet Earth – The Bacteriophage
summary: An animated Kurzgesagt explainer on bacteriophages, viruses that kill bacteria, covering how they infect and burst cells and their potential as therapy against antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
why: HN commenters link it whenever phage therapy or antibiotic resistance comes up, as an accessible overview.

quote.text: Relevant Kurzgesagt video explaining _everything_ about bacteriophage[1].
